note_on_thresholds: Raw model scores are uncalibrated sigmoids; the operating threshold is tuned on train only. The production gate in app/services/gnn_risk.py remains 0.8 (policy threshold).
note: Synthetic benchmark generated by train_gnn.py: fraud and normal feature distributions are drawn from the ranges in sample(); the deterministic stand-in (app/services/gnn_risk._risk_score) is a separate hand-crafted baseline. With 2% symmetric label noise and a 1:7 class imbalance, the theoretical AUC ceiling for a perfect ranker is ~0.94. The GCN consumes identical vectors on all nodes, so it reduces to an MLP on tabular features — see ml/ablation.md for the rule/logistic/boosted/GCN comparison. Replace with labeled production history before real use.
